reader_summary.headline: Hello, and welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research Podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hello, and welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research Podcast. My name is Drew Cohen, and today we're going to be reading our API Group business history. And if you don't know what API Group is, we actually have a 61-page research report on it.

key_points.text: Just in a sentence, it is a high-quality B2B service provider that specializes, at least historically, mostly in fire safety.
key_points.evidence_quote: Just in a sentence, it is a high-quality B2B service provider that specializes, at least historically, mostly in fire safety, but now they have a lot of other business service verticals that they have, and they've been adding more, they just made an elevator acquisition.

key_points.text: And the company's also been undergoing a bit of a transition over the past few years.
key_points.evidence_quote: And the company's also been undergoing a bit of a transition over the past few years, assuring these one-off kind of construction projects they did in favor of more recurring and higher margin service.

key_points.text: And so that is what API Group is in short.
key_points.evidence_quote: And so that is what API Group is in short.

key_points.text: We're going to get into what the business history is, and in case you don't know when we write our research reports.
key_points.evidence_quote: We're going to get into what the business history is, and in case you don't know when we write our research reports, we like to go back to kind of the founding history and talk a lot about how the company was built because the way a business is built has a lot of lessons for an investor.
